invariants.rationale: The method only returns the result of loadMap, and any thrown exception results in the method not returning; so if the method returns, result is expected to be non-null.
tideFile is directly used as a parameter to loadMap; if it were null, a NullPointerException would occur.
A new AssetManagerImageResolver(assetManager) is constructed, which expects a non-null assetManager, or it would throw an exception.
